intro: Young Lovers is an Elwynn Forest quest centered on the forbidden romance between Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield. With their rival families locked in a bitter feud, Maybell enlists an adventurer to secretly courier a heartfelt love letter to Tommy Joe by the riverbank.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh, I'm cursed! My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies. So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!
Please, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe. He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have what?? Maybell is the light of my dull life. Hurry, let me see her letter!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah! I can't stand us being apart. I have to see her!!
